annotations.title: Find the route to remove something from Google

description: Free and read-only. For something about a person that shows in Google (contact details, an ID number, intimate images, doxxing, a false article, old news, a mugshot, a court record, a review, a post, a data broker profile, their own old content, an outdated page, copied work), returns the same plan as the free route finder on essentras.com. Ask only what it is and, where it matters, where the person lives (US, EU, EEA or UK, or elsewhere); never their name or the page address. Returns the route (source, Google policy, law or suppression) and who decides, the steps, the official Google links with the date they were read, the evidence to prepare, a timeline marked official or not, a fit label from Google’s own criteria (not a success rate), letters to send, what the route will not do, a link to the same plan on the website, and the matching Essentras service with its current price. Official channels only. Google, the publisher or the platform decides, and a refund is never a promise of removal.

region.description: Where do you live? This changes which laws and Google features apply to you. us = United States; eu = EU, EEA or UK; other = Somewhere else. Needed only for: contact-info, gov-id, defamatory-article, old-news, mugshot, court-record, data-broker.

situation.description: What do you want gone from Google? Personal details and safety: contact-info = My phone number, home address or email (On any website: a directory, a forum, an old listing); gov-id = A government ID, bank or card number, or private record (Social Security, passport, license or tax ID numbers, bank or card numbers, medical records); intimate-images = Explicit or intimate images of me shared without consent (Photos or video of you, posted without your consent); doxxing = My details posted with threats or harassment (doxxing) (Your address, workplace or family details next to threats). Articles and records: defamatory-article = An article or post that says false things about me (News, blog or forum content with false statements of fact); old-news = An old news story about me (Accurate at the time; now old, resolved or out of date); mugshot = A mugshot or arrest record on a website (A booking photo or arrest listing); court-record = A court record or government page (Court dockets, judgments, registries or agency pages). Posts, reviews and profiles: review = A review about me or my business (On Google, Yelp or a professional review site); social-post = A social media or forum post about me (Posts, comments or threads by someone else); data-broker = A people-search or data broker profile (Profiles listing your address, relatives and age); own-content = Something I posted myself (An old profile, post, photo or website). Something else: outdated-page = A page that was deleted or changed but still shows in Google (The site already acted; Google has not caught up); copyright = My photos, video or writing copied without permission (Work you created, reused on another site); other = Something else, or I am not sure (We will narrow it down).
